sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Close head-and-shoulders portrait of a young clean-shaven man turned strongly toward screen-right in three-quarter view, eyes looking right and slightly downward, dark shaped eyebrows and a small slightly open mouth with dark interior. Short neatly swept-back black hair with a subtle side part and clean temple contour; no hat, glasses, moustache or chin beard. Keep the smooth upper lip and chin; do not turn nose or mouth shadows into facial hair. Olive-grey military tunic fastened high at the neck, thin pale inner collar piping, two rectangular gold collar tabs containing tiny dark/gold motifs, and a round gold button just below the collar closure. Shoulders and lower chest are cropped at the canvas edges; no visible shoulder medals or extra decorations. Forehead, near cheek and nose have strong soft highlights with deeper far-side face and garment shade. Pale grey-green painted background fills all four corners and edges, with no photograph frame, note, text or transparent figure exterior. Preserve the fully backed rectangular composition; measured source alpha249..255 does not define an exterior cutout. Under visible-source-differences-v1 the tiny collar-tab interior symbols are not individually readable; preserve their visible grouped shapes without inventing an identified badge. Keep original hair, brows, rightward head angle, small mouth opening and closed standing-collar structure while fitting a short broad mascot neckline.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal close bust of an older man with a high receding forehead and thin grey-black hair combed backward at the sides/top, dark-grey gently arched eyebrows, narrow calm eyes and a closed neutral mouth. Distinct long grey-brown moustache sweeps outward to the sides, and a separate long pointed grey chin/goatee beard descends below the chin; cheeks remain largely without a full spreading beard. No hat or eyewear. Dark olive formal military coat with a high closed collar covered by dense gold leaf-like embroidery, gold shoulder epaulettes and a red sash running from screen-left shoulder diagonally toward the lower-right chest. Partly cropped medal/ribbon groups are visible along the bottom edge, with a dark suspended medal near the middle-right and red/pale ribbons farther right. Keep their actual locations and broad colours. Soft light highlights forehead, cheeks and beard while the coat centre remains dark. Close centred crop cuts the shoulders and decorations at the lower canvas edge. Full pale grey-green painted background reaches every edge, without frame, overlapping note or transparent exterior. Measured source alpha249..255; preserve the complete opaque-looking original painted rectangle. Evidence limits under visible-source-differences-v1: minute gold embroidery motifs, exact ribbon emblems and individual fine beard strands cannot be read reliably; do not invent named ranks or extra medals. Preserve the outward moustache, pointed goatee, receding hair, formal collar/epaulettes and actual sash arrangement.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Close almost frontal head-and-shoulders portrait with gaze slightly toward screen-left, tidy black hair combed sideways with a clear part and lifted swept front, dark gently arched eyebrows, neutral closed mouth and smooth clean-shaven upper lip, cheeks and chin. No hat, glasses, moustache or beard; subtle under-nose and upper-lip shading must not become facial hair. Very dark navy tunic with a high closed standing collar, thin pale inner collar line and one rectangular gold collar tab on each side, each showing small pale/gold circular details. No visible shoulder boards, medals, sash or tie. Face and torso remain nearly frontal, framed closely above the head and at the lower shoulders. Soft light catches the forehead, nose and cheeks against deeper dark-uniform shade. The muted pale grey-green painted backdrop fills the complete rectangular canvas, with no card frame, paper note, text or transparent figure outline; original alpha255 throughout. Keep the full rectangle and all dark clothing/backing opaque. Evidence limits under visible-source-differences-v1: exact tiny collar-tab icon interiors and individual hair strands are too small to establish; retain the visible tab shapes and do not invent ranks or insignia. Preserve clear source hair/brows, clean chin and closed high collar with a short broad mascot transition.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Close bust of a middle-aged man nearly facing forward with a slight screen-left head/gaze angle, drooping attentive eyes, visible dark short arched brows, a thick dark moustache extending outward and downward at the corners, and no separate chin beard. Lips are closed beneath the moustache. Dark flat-topped peaked cap has a wide rounded crown, a dark band edged by thin brown/gold lines, black glossy visor and a small side fastener near screen-right; no definite central cap badge is visible, so do not add one. Only short dark/grey temple hair is exposed beneath the cap. Dark navy/black broad-lapel coat over a pale shirt and narrow black tie. Narrow shoulder boards have gold/brown edging and small light rectangular marks, and each lapel has a small gold rosette-like mark. Shoulders and lower chest are cut by the canvas. Soft upper/screen-left illumination catches forehead, nose and cheeks, with deeper screen-right and coat shade. Complete pale grey-green painted background reaches every corner; no card frame, paper note or transparent exterior. Measured alpha230..255 still belongs to a full painted rectangle and must not become a cutout. Under visible-source-differences-v1 the tiny shoulder/lapel symbol interiors and exact rank-mark count are not readable; preserve only the actual visible groups without inventing identified insignia. Keep cap, brows, moustache extent, clean chin, tie/lapel structure and short broad collar fit.
